subject: Publicity and logo carveouts in MSA + Order Form — clarification and next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acrosoft.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Collins <ben.collins@acrosoft.com>, legal@acrosoft.com
Date: 2028-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on publicity carveouts in MSA + Order Form

David — thanks for the call earlier. Our legal team reviewed the MSA + Order Form and flagged the publicity / logo language; they asked us to confirm three items so we can proceed to countersign:

1) Are customer references permitted for press releases if we (Acrosoft) request them? The Order Form currently has an 'approval not to be unreasonably withheld' line but legal wants an explicit 30-day review window.

2) Logo usage: MSA says 'reasonable brand guidelines' — can you confirm whether we can include the Redwood logo in product collateral and the limitations (size, placement, co-marketing)?

3) Confidentiality carveout for mutually agreed announcements: Acrosoft needs a carveout so we can jointly issue a press release for our pilot next quarter. Is there a standard mutual-approval workflow or evidence we need to provide?

I'm attaching the redlined Order Form (v3) and a press asset pack for your ops team. Can you loop in the right contacts at Redwood legal and marketing so we can close this out?

Attachments: Acrosoft_OrderForm_redline_v3.pdf, Acrosoft_press_assets_v2.zip

— Sofia
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Acrosoft

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acrosoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on publicity carveouts in MSA + Order Form — working through items

Sofia — thanks for sending this. Looping in Marissa (legal lead) and Monica (customer ops) to propose language and required evidence. Kimberly on marketing will confirm logo usage policy and asset checklist.

Quick answers while the legal team reviews:
- Approval window: Redwood generally uses a 14-business-day approval window for press drafts; we can consider 30 days if Acrosoft needs it, but that can affect go-live timing.
- Logo usage: We allow partner logos in product collateral and partner pages; Kimberly will confirm technical requirements and whether co-marketing is needed for larger use cases.
- Evidence for joint announcement: typically we ask for a draft, an embargo date (if any), and confirmation of the announcement channel. Legal may require an example release or a final signoff flow.

Marissa — can you propose redline language for the Order Form/MSA that addresses a 30-day review and a mutual announcement carveout? If possible include a fallback if approval isn't provided in the window.

Thanks all — I want to get this over the line this week so the pilot can be announced in Q4.

— David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acrosoft.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-19T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on publicity carveouts in MSA + Order Form — proposed redlines

Hi all — reviewed Acrosoft's redline (thanks Sofia). Attached is a short summary (redline_summary_david_20280819.docx) and inline proposed language below. I kept changes minimal to avoid reopening unrelated commercial terms.

Proposed Order Form / MSA inserts:

1) Publicity / Reference Rights (Order Form §7.x)
"Either party may make public announcements regarding the existence of the business relationship subject to the other party's prior written approval of the announcement text. The approving party shall not unreasonably withhold, condition or delay such approval and shall provide any approval or request for reasonable changes within thirty (30) calendar days of receipt of the draft announcement. If no response is provided within the thirty (30) day period, approval will be deemed granted.

2) Logo Use
"Customer may use Provider's trademarks and logos solely as set forth in the Provider's published brand guidelines. Provider shall provide an art-ready logo package and usage guidelines within five (5) business days of request. Any use beyond product collateral or partner pages (including paid advertising or resale) requires prior written consent.

3) Confidentiality carveout for joint announcements
"Notwithstanding the Confidentiality provisions, both parties may disclose the existence of the relationship for a jointly-approved announcement related to the Pilot. The parties will exchange draft announcements at least thirty (30) calendar days before public release and follow the approval process in Section 7.x. Each party may redact confidential technical details not necessary for the announcement.

Requested evidence: draft announcement, proposed embargo date (if any), and logo usage mockups. If Acrosoft can provide these assets we can route copy review to marketing and legal in parallel.

Sofia — two operational notes:
- If you need a hard 30-day review (not 14), we should calendar a tentative release window and mark dependencies in the mutual action plan.
- If Acrosoft expects us to provide a case study quote, we need to capture that separately (consent language + opt-in).

Kimberly — can you confirm the asset acceptance checklist and any additional branding constraints?

— Marissa
Lead, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acrosoft.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Sofia — thanks for the assets. Quick checklist for logo use and announcement prep:

Required for logo approval:
- Art-ready logos (vector .svg or .eps) — thanks for the zip, will confirm files inside.
- Usage mockup (where the logo will appear) — product page screenshot or slide.
- A short use-case statement (1-2 sentences) describing how Redwood is referenced.

Production notes:
- Size/clearspace: follow our brand doc; we will send a single-page guideline once we confirm the exact logo file.
- Co-branded marketing (joint webinars, paid ads): requires separate co-marketing approval and may require attribution language.

Timelines: once we have the draft announcement + assets, marketing can return feedback within 5 business days. Legal's 30-day review would be the gating item for final sign-off.

Sofia — I took a quick look at Acrosoft_press_assets_v2.zip and I see .svg and two product screenshots. I'll upload them to the shared folder and send the one-page guideline.

— Kim
Head of Marketing Programs
Redwood Inference
